**FINDING #12 (CP-A2b live): gitlab.mjs issueView hardcodes glab CLI → crashes in node:20 CI image → issue-link fail-closed; fixtures inject fetchIssue so never caught it**

What: CP-A2b ran LIVE on the gitlab.com mirror. Validated: all 8 jobs ran (include: resolved), actor-check warn+pass (Amendment 3 confirmed), MR-A (no issue link) BLOCKED at rung 1. BUT MR-B failed `issue-link`: the REQUIRED gate's `defaultFetchIssue` → `getVcs().issueView` → `gitlab.mjs` runs `glab api`, and the CI image (node:20) has NO `glab` binary → the spawn crashes → fail-closed (correct DIRECTION, but the trigger is infrastructure, not a real governance failure).

Why the fixtures missed it: every run-check/issue-link test INJECTS `fetchIssue` (dependency injection for hermeticity), so no test ever EXECUTES the real provider binary. The seam's injectability — the same property that makes tests hermetic (finding #10) — HID a real image dependency. Testing lesson: an injectable-seam suite proves the LOGIC but not that the DEFAULT implementation runs in the target environment; a CI-consumed verb needs a test asserting it spawns no external CLI (or an env-level smoke).

DESIGN DECISION (drafted; reviewer rules): (a) install glab per job (before_script) — REJECTED-lean: an image dependency in EVERY consumer, and an include: that demands a CLI install weakens ADR-0018's portability (the core argument). (b) rewrite the CI-consumed GitLab provider verbs over DIRECT API v4 fetch with VCS_TOKEN — reviewer's lean, and MINE: zero image deps, coherent with the repo's zero-dep policy, glab stays for local interactive. PRECEDENT EXISTS IN-REPO: ci-context.mjs `defaultFetchMr` (loadGitlabContext) already fetches direct API v4 (CI_API_V4_URL ?? gitlab.com/api/v4, PRIVATE-TOKEN header, ProxyAgent(HTTPS_PROXY)). issueView is a simple GET `/projects/:encoded/issues/:iid` → mirror that helper (factor it shared). Cost: LOW.

Doctrine this sets: CI-consumed provider verbs must be CLI-FREE (direct API). Extends to actor-check's `gh`-hardcoded fetchLabeledEvents (m3) — same class, A3 territory.

PENDING (do NOT start until the log): local-checks ALSO failed on both MRs — suspicion: a seam test coupled to real git + the runner's shallow clone (candidate: the A1 `git diff HEAD...HEAD` ci-context test). Awaiting the log before any fix.

Where: brain/scripts/vcs/providers/gitlab.mjs issueView (glab), brain/scripts/vcs/ci-context.mjs defaultFetchMr (the direct-fetch template), brain/scripts/governance/run-check.mjs defaultFetchIssue. Related: [[sdd/issue-231-a2/done]], [[findings/github-issuelink-bash-hardcoded-main]].
